voice_authorization: Creator explicitly selected Holden as default on 2026-10-30.
controls_status: Rate 30 remains a provisional new-project starting point. The creator found Apollo 12 at rate40 slightly rushed and insufficiently expressive; do not promote that preset by duration alone.
delivery_goal: Engaged conversational storytelling with meaning-led emphasis, pitch/rhythm variation, comfortable explanation and decisive accents. Allow action and sound space; do not rush every clause.
creative_priority: Quality and detailed expressive direction take priority over price; do not shorten useful performance cues solely to reduce cost.

calibration.policy: Start at native rate30. If rushed, compare once at a slower supported rate such as20 with the same text and performance. Judge expression, intelligibility and purposeful space by listening; WPM is a soft planning range, not a pass score or a percentage mapping.

pause_edit.policy: Run preparation on new narration before selection and cut timing by default. Keep brief natural pauses, breaths and quiet consonants. Protect specifically directed holds by exact interval, preserve raw sources and the edit map, use tempo 1.0 and add no generic scene padding. Existing accepted audio changes require creator authorization.

tempo_edit.purpose: Optional modest pitch-preserving adjustment after measured generation, separate from pause editing.

scope: Defaults for new projects unless overridden. Preserve accepted existing files and exact voice identity; this preset is not listening approval.
